visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed, full-viewport-width rotating hero. Each slide is a dark background image with a large heading and two CTA buttons overlaid on the left. Thin dash-style slide indicators anchored bottom-left. Auto-advances.
contentPattern: First row labels the block ('Carousel'). Each subsequent row is one slide: cell 1 = background image, cell 2 = heading + optional description + up to two CTA links.
usage: Top-of-page hero banner with multiple rotating promotional slides.
